ben._.rocco: Bastian "Saint" Rocco arrived at S-F15 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam corrected the cap; the first puddle corrected the rest.

Bastian "Saint" Rocco hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back. Verdel Ridge has been won. Bastian "Saint" Rocco listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Bastian "Saint" Rocco sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour.
An officer heard about the singing and forbade it. Tonight Bastian "Saint" Rocco only whistled the first bar. Across the wire, someone whistled the last.
rylan_45h: In Wyvern Cross, Ivo "Bones" Rylan was a bookbinder. In R-F8, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a bookbinder again.
Orders assigned Ivo "Bones" Rylan to work as a machine gunner. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Ivo "Bones" Rylan added a leak above the man's head in pencil. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Ivo "Bones" Rylan looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Ivo "Bones" Rylan pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Ivo "Bones" Rylan read a theatre review while peeling supper.
v01py: Bastian "Lucky" Vpy took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Bastian "Lucky" Vpy answered the first call, number 18 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Someone asked Bastian "Lucky" Vpy to wake them in ten minutes. He spent all ten worrying about how to measure them.

Bastian "Lucky" Vpy held the mirror while Felix Topekeno shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord at dusk. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Felix Kagr lent Bastian "Lucky" Vpy a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.'

Felix Kagr and Bastian "Lucky" Vpy divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion. A letter from home reached Bastian "Lucky" Vpy before dusk. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy read it twice and slept a little easier.
